winfsp.description: WinFsp - Windows File System Proxy (required by VirtioFS)

virtiofs.description: Virtio-win Guest Tools (includes VirtioFS driver). Version and URL come from linux/windows-vm/virtio-source.sh; the host resolves them into this file before the bundle reaches the guest.
